mots.sens: Issachar is a name that means 'he has been rewarded.' This name is derived from the Hebrew root that evokes the notion of reward and wages. Spiritually, Tola reminds us that even in our weaknesses, God calls us to be instruments of His grace.

Pua is a name that can be translated as 'noise' or 'sound,' and it is often associated with joy or exclamation. This name evokes the notion of celebration and recognition of God's goodness. In the context of genealogy, Pua reminds us that each family member has a role to play in the divine plan, and that their existence is a source of praise.
